architecture.features: Unchanged Phase25 assess_prediction_readiness -> feature_row.as_frame, exact42 canonical ordered columns; no frontend features or duplication

architecture.model: Existing backend.services.model_bundle cache -> ml/src/model_inference.py native verified artifact; no alternative construction/load path

prediction_semantics.source_timestamp: Latest stored feature-compatible origin t, naive building-local
prediction_semantics.forecast_timestamp: source + stored horizon10minutes, returned from persisted context
prediction_semantics.prediction_wh: Appliances energy for next ten-minute interval; not measured consumption or instantaneous power
prediction_semantics.current_appliances_wh: Recovered from exact stored snapshot; labels source measurement, not necessarily current building latest

persistence.table: Existing predictions, no duplicate prediction table
persistence.atomicity: One row contains prediction plus complete recommendation and exact feature snapshot; flush/response validation before single commit; DB failures rollback and return safe503, no success claim
persistence.trend: Not persisted; no extra trend schema

fingerprint.snapshot: Ordered feature_names and feature_values only; no user/session/owner metadata
fingerprint.new_latest: New source creates new history row, preserving old forecasts
fingerprint.historical_correction: Changed consumed features create new fingerprint/version even at same source/model; original retained; restoring identical inputs reuses old result
fingerprint.irrelevant_history_change: No new record when model input unchanged
fingerprint.concurrency: Database uniqueness enforces one record; loser returns winner after rollback; concurrent two-request test returns one shared ID
fingerprint.legacy: Nullable paired hash/snapshot preserve old predictions; no guessed inputs/fingerprint/recommendations, never labeled current

migration.reason: Reliable concurrent and historical-edit-aware idempotency plus per-prediction audit inputs
migration.tests: Metadata comparison, legacy upgrade/downgrade/reupgrade preservation, snapshot pair/unique constraints and offline PostgreSQL DDL compilation pass; no live PostgreSQL server test
migration.downgrade: Preserves scalar rows but removes added input-audit columns/context

history_current_context.strategy: Read-only Phase25 assessment and metadata checksum plus per-row source/hash/model/horizon comparison; no model or recommendation execution
history_current_context.matches_current_history: Only true for a snapshot matching currently assessed compatible inputs and model identity; legacy/unverifiable rows false
history_current_context.measurement_changes: Invalidate history/context alongside measurements/readiness; preserve old records and mark historical, including changed fingerprint at same source
history_current_context.availability: History remains readable when model artifact cannot be loaded; invalid metadata disables current-match confirmation, not historical rows

frontend.cache: Existing QueryClient; account/building/page keys, scoped confirmed-success invalidation, 401 session/409 readiness revalidation
frontend.ui: Explicit Predict next10minutes button disabled during not-ready/loading/recheck; no auto POST; stored predicted Wh/source/target/horizon/recommendation, measured-at-source label, paginated newest-first history and safe errors
frontend.historical_label: Latest stored forecast distinct from current matching context; later page says stored snapshot; background rechecks do not affirm current match

known_limitations: Other buildings remain experimental; compatible inputs do not establish external validation
Rechecks are not a serializable reservation; snapshots record consumed inputs, and concurrent later changes can make a result historical
Existing verified model/threshold cache lasts until process restart; no dummy fallback for unavailable uncached resources
Concurrent SQLite contention/lost responses can require idempotent retry/history inspection
Offset pagination can shift under writes; legacy rows have no new input provenance
Tiny feature/runtime serialization differences after a future environment change may intentionally produce a new fingerprint
Threshold rules remain fixed Phase14; idempotency does not version thresholds separately
No scheduler, final cross-building dashboard redesign, admin management, IoT, automatic actuation, savings or confidence intervals
phase27_readiness: Authenticated persisted forecasts/recommendations and private history are available for later authorized dashboard integration; Phase27 not started
